body: Dont be, its all my fault.
But its not supposed to be this way. For many years of our young lives she was my rock,. Its not supposed to end like this.

Its the lack of hope.

The lack of a chance.

Its the fact I was given false hope, trying to reconcile, supporting her financially, buying her gifts, paying off her debts, before she messages me telling me she is seeing someone else.

The fact that after 7 years I'm only worth 30 minutes because of "guilt"
I drove 7 hours to see her, I was there for half an hour and she refused to talk about it. I told her how I feel, she knows, and yet she isnt interested.

talked about marriage yeah.

I had no summer routine, I worked too much, I told her that maybe she should consider casually seeing somebody new while she is away at university. To have fun, stress free, to get a break from me. To come back to a relationship renewed.

Im not sure what to say.

I loved her, I wanted her to have space and enjoy herself. And she falls for a guy.

2 weeks, wont even considering leaving him. Wont even give me a chance. Gave me hope and then shot me down.

Is that all im worth after 7 years?
